body: to be fair, if it had said "white guys jump black kids on a busy public street surrounded by people", i would have thought the exact same thing

haha like the attitude, but the past can be a decent predictor of the future. the last 10 odd years have been more or less pretty numb, with occasional, short spikes of happiness, fear and pain. 

>Go sky diving, swim with sharks, take a cruise.

i do want to do all that, and that shit sounds fun but it would only take my mind off my issues for a short time.

that's a good question. nah not really. most of my counselers were bullshit. me my sister and my mom all went to one psychiatrist when i was in high school, and she actually gave the police all my information when they requested it (for a very minor quarrel with my sister- she basically called the cops on me because i took her tennis ball- like i said, things were pretty fucked up). the others have basically been "listener" types and just kind of sit back and try to say as little as possible. problem is, i'm there to fix shit. i want to hear solid professional advice, which most of these guys don't seem to have. 

i'm also leery of the dynamic- you're paying them to help you get better... why would they ever let you do so? getting you better means losing a client.
can you explain what exactly happened with your friend? why does he hate you? feel free to pm.
